payload.reason: Owner requested full information preservation from https://update.fedrv.de/ before changing it, with presentation matching the main FEDRV site.
additional_scope: Capture immutable HTML/assets/link manifest for the landing page and reachable public documentation.
Render copied information locally in the shared four-color EN/DE/RU shell; remap copied documentation links locally so source redesign does not remove access.

additional_acceptance.criterion: Every captured first-party information page and its content are preserved, with per-page hashes and a source-to-local route coverage check.
The imported landing/detail pages use the current shared style, remain readable at 360/1440px and retain current language-selection behavior.

exclusions: No external authenticated or private operational pages
